talas.t: Still awake. Neftchi fans still gloating in the other group I see 😒
Let them. 63 to 62, it's in the history books now
Kayırluu tañ Talas! Brr, my car windscreen was white with frost 🥶
Frost in the valleys too. Good for the potatoes in the cellar, bad for the hands digging
Kayırluu tañ! Mountains are white again on top. Saw it from the bus
Kayırluu tañ 🙂 Nurzhan smog this morning is worse than Talas, my eyes are burning
Talas is moderate today, Nurzhan is unhealthy for sensitive groups. Wear a mask if you drive in there
Pulled into Bazar-i Kalan 10 min ago. Lines at the changers already. Dollar is at 11.85 to sell, buy 11.50 🤷
That's a lot higher than the official 8.40. Tourists must hate it lol
Officially it's 8.40 and it has been since 2008. Everyone at the booths knows the difference, we just don't say it out loud
Who's going to the Irad Cup final on Saturday? Neftchi v Attelkom at Silk Road Arena, 14:00
Season ticket holder here, so I'm not going to the Cup. Tulpar is still the team for me 💙
Attelkom will do it, I can feel it. Neftchi won the league by a point, they're tired
Tired? They beat us 2-1 on the last day 😂
Quick question, my customer brought a phone with a cracked screen and asked if it's worth fixing or buying new. Any advice?
Ask him what he paid. If it's old, buy used. If it's new, fix it
Ok rahmat. He's buying used then 😄
Diesel at 6.10 at the Talas station near the Trans-Talas road. Still hurts before the harvest is sold
Tyre shop is quiet this week. Everyone waits for winter tyres to become a must on the Fergana road, then the rush
Kids came in with red noses today. Heating in the kindergarten is on, but the rooms are still cold in the mornings
Poor kids. Bring a scarf for the little ones 🧣
[poll: Will the Cup final be on TV or only at the stadium?]
Nobody knows yet, I checked the Herald and nothing
Anyone know if the Kara-Buura club bus leaves from the North Terminal? 🙏
Usually from the Communications Square, ask at the Kara-Buura fan stand
Rahmat! Kara-Buura plays on Saturday so I'll take the bus
Reminder: my English/Iradi exchange is Thursday again, 18:30 at the teahouse behind the philology building. Bring friends!
I'll be there. Going to practise 'the phone is fixed' in Iradi
Lunch rush at the Talasbank branch. Everyone wants to change money for the Uzbek trip 😩
Same here at the booth. Tell them the Uzbek bazar is cheaper, the changers keep fighting for the euro
Lunch break. Plov at the canteen for 28 som, not bad for a Friday 🍚
Plov is nice but my two horses at the Hippodrome want hay. Hay bale is 26 som in the valleys now, it was 22 in the spring
Hay is always up before winter. Buy early or pay more later, same story every year
Potatoes 2.10 per kilo at the stall now. My uncle says the Kazakh lot is coming in February as usual 😂
Your uncle always says that lol
[sticker: haha]
Anyone else see the Kazakhstan apology news? Comic said sorry. Herald says Irad recalls Swift Hooves and Homer's kazy from shelves
Kazy is my favourite 😭 Hope it comes back soon
Swift Hooves was just a cartoon, why recall it? Kids will be sad
My kids watch it on Saturdays. They will ask me tomorrow where it went 😅
Still no news on the Kyrgyz wrestler at Astana, silver is nice though. Irad didn't have a team there, that's a pity
Silver from Astana is still silver, don't be sad 🥈
Going to the Jibek Jolu area this afternoon. Aunt's stall is still closed. Fire report still not out
Sorry Nurbek. Tell her to come to the booth, we can find her a corner
Rahmat sister 🙏
Who is watching the ulak this weekend? Naiman v Tanıp at 15:00, I'm going with Gulzada
Yes! Naiman grounds, Saturday 15:00. Bring a blanket, it gets cold in the afternoon 🧣
Tanıp still second on 19. Naiman on 11. Good chance for Tanıp to pull away
Boztorgoy are top on 24 though. Let's see who blinks first
Traffic on Liberty Boulevard is bad again. Taxi from the centre 15 som minimum and they still argue 😤
Use the marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr, 30 som, it's faster than waiting for taxis
Anyone know a good 1-room flat near the TSU? Budget is around 1,000 som a month
1,000 to 1,500 is the normal range in Talas centre. Near TSU a bit more. Iyık Janyl is 600 to 1,000 if you can travel
Ok, I'll look a bit further out. Rahmat
Kids are asleep. Time for my tea ☕
Tea is good. Toktogul reservoir is at 86% now, I checked again. Still dropping though
Timur you are a worrier 😂 Let's wait for the rain
Who wants to hear about the Highland table again? Boztorgoy 24, Tanıp 19, Karatau 16, Karakoyun 15 😄
Marat we know, we're all reading the same table 😂
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 som a kilo. My cousin says the Jalal-Abad ones are better. Don't believe him
22? Hmm, that's cheaper than I thought. Not sure what a kilo of walnuts is worth to you, but OK
[sticker: jailoo]
Sunset is at 18:30 and the cold is coming fast 🥶
Nurzhan air is still 138 on the AQI, Talas is 87. Glad I moved here 😅
Kech jakshı everyone 🌙 Ready for the weekend?
Saturday: Sary-Bulak v Kyzyl-Adyr at 16:00 in ulak, Nurzhan v Chu at 17:00 in Chu ISEZ. Lots going on
Talas v Semiz at 19:00 at the State Hippodrome, then Köhne Diz v Dastgoh at 21:00. I will be there for the 19:00
Good, the Hippodrome is my favourite place to be on a Saturday evening
Ulak is not football right? I always mix up the Conference names 😅
Right Aizada, ulak with horses. Football is Kara-Buura and the Irad League. Different sports, same love 🐎
Kara-Buura had a bad end to the season, 25 points, 9th place. Next year we fly
Next year. Keep saying that. Attelkom will be the Cup winners on Saturday though, watch
Saturday evening with the kids at home, we're making boorsok 🥟
Boorsok and the Tulpar match on TV, what more does a man need
Irad Highland play-off semi-finals on the 12th at the Hippodrome. Boztorgoy at the top, we'll see who makes it
Highland place 2 v ISEZ place 1 at 19:00, then Highland 1 v ISEZ 2 at 21:00. Bring a jacket!
Thanks Marat, I'll bring my students. They want to see the horses, not the football 😂
[sticker: salam]
The Talas power is steady tonight, no cuts planned. Good for the heating
My fixed phone counter has heating on at last. Customers keep coming in just to warm up 😄
Toktogul is 16.38 km3 now, 86.2% full. Water is coming down and it's cold enough, the exports are on schedule
Enough with the dam numbers Timur 😂 Who's coming for boorsok on Thursday?
[sticker: kosh]
Dollar on the street rate, not the official one. Still 8.40 on paper lol
Ha, Elnur. Keep it quiet, the whole market is listening
Who's going to the Women's League? Universitet v Iyık Janyl was 3-2 last round, Tulpar Talas top on 23
Tulpar on top, Universitet second on 22. Nice race for the girls 💪
Tulpar women drew 2-2 with Akademiya, I was there. A point is a point
Tınç uyku Talas 🌙
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Still thinking about the Neftchi derby. Tulpar, next season we get them 🔴
Nurbek go to sleep 😂 Bus 14 at 8:40 tomorrow again?
I'll be at the stop at 8:30. Promise, again
Night Talas. Saturday is the final, the Hippodrome, the ulak, all of it 🐎
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Tınç uyku 🐎
Good night 🌙
Night all 🌙
Still awake. Tulpar women's result still in my head 😂
Morning Talas. Horses at the Hippodrome already, the grooms are up before the sun
Kayırluu tañ! Brr, the fog is sitting on Nurzhan again, saw it on the Herald site
Talas is clear and cold here, 1 degree on my balcony thermometer 🥶 Kayırluu tañ all
Clear sky in Talas and I'm not complaining. My cousin in Nurzhan says he can't see the chimney across the street
Bus 14 to Semiz today? Please tell me it came on time
Came at 8:20 for me, normal. Driver had the heater on full, I was roasting
Lucky. Mine was packed to the door, I stood the whole way
Anyone going to the Irad Cup final tomorrow? Neftchi v Attelkom at Silk Road Arena, 14:00
I'm on the early shift at the bank tomorrow so no. Hope someone films it for us 🙏
Attelkom in a cup final after the season they had. Good for them
Potatoes at Bazar-i Kalan are 2.10 a kilo now, Bakyt, you were right about the sacks being cheaper
Take the sack, 4 ha and I still can't sell mine 😅 no, I'm joking, prices are fine this year
Anyone know a 1-room flat near the North Terminal? Looking for something under 1,500 som a month
Talas 1-room is 1,000 to 1,500 a month, the cheap end is further out. Ask at the notice board in the Tündük cafe, people post there
Rahmat! I'll go Thursday after the exchange
Kids wake up at 6 and I still can't. Fine, I'm at the bus stop at 8:30 Monday, I promise 😅
We'll see. Talas hears you every Monday Nurbek
Dollar at the booths this morning: 11.45 buy, 11.90 sell. Street is the same as yesterday. Ha, Elnur, I'm not saying anything
I said nothing 🙈
Two horses at the stables still have their winter blankets off, Bakyt, you'd laugh at them, they look like coats
Horses in coats, that's Talas for you 😂
Lunch at the Talasbank counter was pilaf and a queue. Nothing else to report 🍚
Thursday exchange: I'll bring tea and the cards. Who else is coming?
I'll try. My three are back to school on Monday after the holiday so Thursday is free
Count me in, I'll bring my bad Iradi and a dictionary
Anyone else's heating radiator just sitting cold? Ours is on but it's like warm air only
Bleed the top valve with a key, works 80% of the time. My counter's radiator did that 😄
Rahmat, will try after lunch
Talas District Court: nothing today, the coin name case stays adjourned to November. Don't go all the way down for nothing
Thanks for the update Begaiym, I'd heard it was still going
Who wants to see the Hippodrome on the 12th? Highland semi-finals. Bring a jacket, the wind is cold
I'll bring the students again, they want the horses not the football 😂
Two snow leopards on camera in upper Besh-Tash, the Herald says. My kids want to go look, I said no 😂
Snow leopards in Besh-Tash, first in decades. Good news. I hope the herders get something for their sheep though
Leopard doesn't pay for the sheep Bakyt, the herders know that
The article didn't say anything about compensation. Typical
Anyone checking the Talas-Nurzhan marshrutka prices? 38 som now and the bus is 32. Ok, I just take the bus
The bus is fine. Marshrutka is faster but you pay for it 😄
Toktogul reservoir is 86.0% full this evening, 16.34 km3, still drawing down. I know, I know, Aizada 😂
Ha, OK Timur 😂 at least it's on the screen somewhere
Tyre shop had 3 winter tyre jobs today. Chatkal road is getting busy with chains and studs. Careful at the top
Did you see the Fergana Gateway is open but chains are required? My cousin drove up, said it's fine with winter tyres
Chains required. My Lada just has its regular tyres, I'm not going anywhere 😂
Dinner is on the table. Plov tonight from my sister's kitchen, 28 som for a plate at the bazar but mine is free 🍚
Free plov is the only good plov
Tulparcoin is on a little tear today, 3.42 cents, up 3.3%. Still not legal tender, so I'm not buying anything with it
Nobody is buying it Begaiym, people are just watching the numbers 😂
Evening all. Tomorrow the cup final, then the Women's League is over until spring
Women's League ended with Tulpar on 23 and Universitet on 22. Nice finish for the girls
Tulpar women drew with Akademiya and then won the title on points, I'm still proud 🔴
Tulpar women, first place, I'll take it
Who is going to the Irad Cup tomorrow? I'll watch on TV with my flatmate
Neftchi 1-0 up in my head already. Attelkom need a miracle lol
Attelkom have been the surprise. Would not bet against them
Ulak fans, the Talas State Hippodrome round is on the 7th at 19:00, that's Talas v Semiz. Coming to watch?
Talas v Semiz at 19:00 on the Hippodrome. My horses are running in the warm-up, I'll be there
Also Köhne Diz v Dastgoh at 21:00 at the Hippodrome. Late night match, bring a jacket
Chu v Nurzhan at 17:00 on the plain. Nurzhan took two points off Kara-Buura last time, sort of. Be careful ulak fans 😂
Nurbek there are no Kara-Buura at the ulak 😂 that's football!
Sorry Gulzada, I mixed them up, sorry 🙈
Power in Talas steady tonight. No cuts planned. Good for the heating
Heating on at the counter and the smog is in my throat. Nurzhan is at AQI 188, I'm glad I'm in Talas (138)
Still 138 in Talas, unhealthy for sensitive groups. Keep the windows shut Rustam, the children at my school are coughing
My kindergarten kids are fine, I keep the windows closed. Thank you for the warning 🙏
Iyık Janyl is 151 on the air app. Bad for everyone there
In the village the fog sits in the valley all day. Wood smoke everywhere. Don't blame the fog
Kayırluu, good night for the weekend. Anyone want to go to the Silk Road Arena tomorrow?
Silk Road is far from the centre, take a taxi, from 15 som. Don't get in a car with a stranger 😅
Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale this year. Dear, my horses eat like kings
Hay at 26 and my potatoes at 2.10. We're all paying for the winter
Who is coming to the Thursday exchange? Still boorsok, still tea. Rustam, bring the dictionary 😂
Dictionary is ready. My Iradi is still chala though
Irad Cup tomorrow, Silk Road Arena, 14:00. Neftchi Nurzhan v Attelkom Talas. Go Attelkom, not that I'm biased 😂
Timur, you ARE biased, you wear the Tulpar scarf 😂
Ok, one poll: who wins the Irad Cup tomorrow?
[poll: Irad Cup final winner?]
Neftchi, they're the champions, I can't see it going any other way 🐎
Attelkom, my nephew plays for their youth side, I'm biased too 😊
Neftchi 2-0 and I'll eat my hat 😂
Hats are for the Hippodrome 🧢 Let's see what happens tomorrow
Leopards on camera in Besh-Tash, I still can't believe it. Imagine seeing one
Upper Besh-Tash is far. Not going up there in November
Enjoy the cup everyone. Tınç uyku Talas 🌙
Tınç uyku 🌙
Night Talas. Tomorrow the cup, the ulak, the Hippodrome, all of it 🐎
Tınç uyku 🐎
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Good night 🌙
Night all 🌙
cannot sleep, the leopard video again 😂
Kayırluu tañ! Talas is clear and cold this morning, mountains white again ❄️
Clear for the whole day they say. Good for the potatoes in the store, no rain
Kayırluu! Going to the Hippodrome later? Irad Cup is tomorrow not today, I keep mixing it up 😅
Not today. Cup is Sat... wait it was Sat, now it's Sunday, the cup was yesterday lol
Yesterday, Neftchi 2-0 would've been nice, instead 2-1 to Tulpar. not complaining 😎
sorry the cup was the 7th, the league was 31 Oct. I'm confusing myself
Morning. Neftchi won the cup 2-0 yesterday, I was right 🐎
Marat you were NOT right, the cup is 14:00 next Sat... I'm lost. Coffee first
Ok, the bus question. Is the 14 running on Sunday or the Sunday timetable? Nurzhan side seems fine
Sunday timetable, so fewer buses. Plan 10 min extra 🙂
Ignore the poll, I meant to post something else
Bars the dog is back to the kiosk, Nurbek, you saw him there?
No, that was last week. Bars is fat now, Gulzada take him to the vet
He eats everything from the Attelkom canteen bins 🙄
Hay in the valleys still 26 a bale. Whoever has spare, ping me, I need 20 bales before the snow
Who sold you hay at 26 when the Chu one is cheaper? Go to Kara-Buura side, they sell from the farms
My horses don't eat Chu hay, they're spoiled. Wrong grass 😤
Old City at breakfast smells of tandyr bread and smoke, i love it 🥖
Nan is 3.50 a loaf at the corner shop now, still jakshı
Air in Talas says 102 on the app, unhealthy for sensitive people. Kids should stay in
My three are coughing since Friday. Doctor says just keep them in the warm room
Sorry Gulzada, hope they feel better soon 💛
Nurzhan is worse, 183 today. Don't go there without a mask
Our branch had a queue of old ladies this morning asking about the pension card. Nice Sunday shift 😅
Lunch at the plov place by the bus station? 28 a plate and they still give bread
Yes if they still have the good meat. Last time it was all bone
Come to the counter after, I fixed a phone for 20 som, wait I mean I'll fix anything, just ask
Changers on Bazar-i Kalan this morning: 11.50 buy, 11.90 sell for dollars. Euro 12.65/13.25. Rubles, 100 is 13.25 buy
Rubles are cheap now. My son in Russia asks me every week to send, hard to see the difference
The bank rate is 8.40 for the dollar, the booths take a cut. Everybody knows, nobody says
Herald wrote about it again, the families who get money from Russia lose a lot in fees
I'm not supposed to say what we charge 🙃 but the Herald is right
Ok, let's not get into remittances on a Sunday 😂 who's coming Thursday?
Tulparcoin is at 3.41 cents today according to the news. Nobody I know can even buy it, lol
Crypto is for Almaty people. I'll stay with the som
Ulak tartysh Kara-Bulak next Saturday, Hippodrome? Marat you coming with the horses
If they are not sold out. Maybe I bring the grey
ISEZ round 10 is the 14th, Talas plays Dastgoh at the State Hippodrome, 21:00 🐎
21:00 is late, I'll come after the bazar
Talas v Dastgoh, we need the points. Two in a row would be good
Anyone else's Tulpar scarf now a bit dirty from the cup? Hahaha
Washed it. Ready for the 14th 🧣
Tulpar sticker here: [sticker: tlpr_up]
Kids asleep, I finally have an hour. Tea?
Tea yes 🍵
Power is normal in Talas today? Lights blinked around 16:00
Blinked here too, then fine. No cut scheduled as far as I know
Heat is on at the block, so good
The Silk Road taxi back to the centre is from 15 som if you share 🚕
Shared taxi, sure. I'll get the grey home from the stables then
Anyone know if the Sunday market at Jibek Jolu reopened? Nurbek's aunt asked
Not yet, court says the fire report is still pending. She's been at home 2 months
Sorry for her 💛 hope the report comes soon
Who wants to practise English on Thursday? I'll bring the flashcards 🇬🇧
Me, dictionary is ready 😂
I'll come, bring boorsok? someone said it's always there
Always 🙂
Anyone watching the Talas Symphony on Saturday? Or is it too cold to go out
Too cold, I'll stay in with tea. Sorry Elnur
Cold is fine, we have heating. Just the air is bad 😷
Petrol AI-92 is 5.40 at my village station. Drove to Talas and back this week, the tank is a lot lighter
Diesel 6.10 for the tractor. Everything is expensive except the nan
Bars just came back from the kiosk with a bag of bread 🙈
Bars has better taste than us 😂
Who saw the snow leopards story? Two on camera in upper Besh-Tash. Still can't believe it
Yes, I said that already last night 😅 they're rare, my grandfather never saw one
No compensation for the herders, the Herald says. That's the part that matters
Herders need to be paid for lost sheep first, then leopards. My view
Both things can be true 🙂
Silk Road Arena tomorrow with the ulak? No, let me check, I think it's the Hippodrome
Hippodrome, Talas v Dastgoh is the 14th, tomorrow there's nothing I know of, just the Sunday
[poll: Thursday exchange: boorsok or plov?]
Boorsok is a classic. Vote 🙂
Boorsok 🐎
Plov, but only if Elnur cooks
Ha, no. Boorsok 🥟
Neftchi won the cup 2-0 so we're all good. Season is 1 point off Neftchi, Tulpar 2nd, one round left 🧣
Last round is 14th? No, the league ended 31 Oct, the table is final. Tulpar second, 62 points
Right, the league is done, 27 rounds. Second place is fine, we had a great year 🧣
Good season for Talas anyway 🙌
Night soon. Potatoes sorted for the winter, thank God
Tınç uyku after this, kids need to sleep too
Good night all, the booth opens early tomorrow 🌙
Tınç uyku 🐎
Night Talas 🌙
Good night 🌙
Night all, fog tomorrow in Nurzhan so stay safe on the road 🌙

nurzhan.t: Инверсия не уходит, фонари в тумане как ватные
Доброе утро. Финал сегодня? Нет, завтра 😅 Голова уже путается
Доброе утро, Нуржан! На Навбахоре опять +16 дома, котельная обещала до обеда 🙄
Если по старому, то к вечеру. Новые котельные на окраинах хоть работают
Воздух тоже не радует. Дочь в садик в маске пошла, Нуржан 138 по индексу, это уже вредно для детей
138, это US AQI, PM2.5 50,4. Для чувствительных групп. Не катастрофа, но гулять не стоит
Игорь, ты опять как справочник 😄
Good morning! Is the air always like this in Nurzhan in November? In Talas today it's 87, not so bad
Зимой бывает хуже, Aigerim. Талас дальше от завода, поэтому и лучше
Дастгох опять без воды до 14:00? Или это вчерашнее?
Сегодня по громкоговорителю не объявляли вроде. Проверь трубы, Айбек
Ладно, наберу в ванну на всякий 🙃
Ребята, на финал в субботу кто на трибуну? Я уже взял термос
Костя, ты сейчас расскажешь про термос в пятый раз 😂
Шестой, и про шарф тоже
Мужчины, у вас одна тема. Лучше скажите, кто в субботу на ярмарку в Талас, маршрутка 38?
I will go to Talas too! Gate 3, right? Aibek said so 🙏
Да, ворота 3. И после 19:00 лучше не ждать, частники просят 60
Плов на ярмарке в Таласе кто-нибудь брал? Я в прошлый раз 28 отдала и не жалею
Плов за 28 это сейчас норма. Хлеб 3,50, картошка 2,10 — тоже всё как было
Не надо больше цифр за обедом, Оксана 😄
Смотрите, Талас 87 по воздуху, а мы 138. Разница видна даже без индекса, тут дымом пахнет с утра
Это с завода или с котельных? Я в прошлом году заметила
Вместе, наверное. Вечером уже ничего не видно
Вопрос в чат: монеты с Рабат-и-Сафеда дальше будут в лаборатории или музей всё-таки заберёт?
Пока в лаборатории. Исследование ещё не закончили, но музей уже пишет письма
Ну пусть пишут, нам бы ещё кислоту нормальную для чистки 😅
What are the coins? Sorry, I did not hear about it
Old silver coins from the Karakhanid time, found near Rabat-i-Safed. Students are working on them, very interesting 🙂
Wow, rahmat for explaining!
Тулпар с Нефтчи в лиге 62 и 63, а в субботу финал кубка. Для Нефтчи это что, три трофея подряд?
Чемпионы уже есть, Костя. Кубок — отдельно. Но да, Аттелком будет тяжело
Аттелком в женской лиге проиграл Нефтчи 3:0, это было в прошлом туре. Не знаю, что будет в мужском
Ладно, перенесём это на субботу 😂
Кто подскажет, в Нуржане в ЖЭКе можно сейчас сдать показания по газу или только в интернете?
Через окно в ЖЭКе, я сдавала вчера. Очередь небольшая
Цены на квартиры на Дастгохе опять поднимают. Однушка от 750 до 1200, а лучше по старым ценам жить на Иык-Жаныл
Из Иык-Жаныл на работу не наездишься, там 600 — 1000 и туман всю ночь
Aigerim, если ищешь квартиру, в Талас однушка от 1000 до 1500, но до завода ездить далеко
Rahmat! I think Nurzhan is still better for work. Maybe Dastgoh, but I will ask about the windows 😄
Вечером будет тёплая смена у нас в лаборатории, кто-нибудь ещё хочет курсы по русскому для Aigerim?
Пусть Aigerim сначала сама решит. Курсы в Политехе, по вечерам, недорого
Yes, maybe next week. Thank you all 🙏
Ну что, я на вахту в Сургут не еду, пока курс рубля такой. Кто на доллары смотрит?
В Базаре-и-Калан меняют по 11,50 покупка, продажа 11,85. Официальный 8,40. Вот и думай
Разница большая, лучше через Талас банк, хоть и 1,2–2,5% комиссии
Спокойнее, да. Но вахта без наличных — это тоже не жизнь
Вода по Тулпару 3,31 центов на токен, падение нулевое. Это не деньги, никто не покупает
Игорь, какой ещё токен? Ты это серьёзно?
Шутка. Но курс смотреть интересно, что ещё делать в такой туман
Девочки, Талас в субботу в 14:00 или после 19:00? Маршрутка 38 и потом домой
Лучше утром в 9:30 с ворот 3, потом до ярмарки и назад до 17:00
Игра в 14:00 у нас, Костя, ты помнишь?
Помню! Я в шарфе и с термосом, не переживай
Иык-Жаныл сегодня туман с температурой 16 днём, 6 ночью. Инверсия, на улице хорошо только в обед
Айбек, а у тебя Дастгох без тепла, Навбахор с утра холодный. Держись
Держусь 🧣
Ночи, всем тепла 🧣
Ночи 🌙
Good night! Football final tomorrow, I will watch from the stand, not sure yet 😊

Poll: best use of Sunday in the valley?
[poll: Sleep, Market, Football on the radio, Cellar digging]
Sleep. Obviously 😴
Ulak on the radio. The dog votes too, he is already at the door
Mother made plov for the whole street, 28 som a plate if you were paying, we are not 😄

[sticker: tlpr_up]

Tulpar still 1 point behind Neftchi in the league, Ulan will be sad 😂

Night is coming. Gn soon. Keep the stove in, Sapar, not your box, ours 😄

Walnuts 22, potatoes 2.10, hay 26. Somebody tell me something good before bed

[sticker: jailoo]

My grandson bought some, now he talks about nothing else
[sticker: bilbeim]
Marshrutka Kyzyl-Adyr–Talas still 30 som. Driver says diesel is 6.10 now, so for now

Colt is already at the manger. Ooba he eats better than the whole family 😍
[sticker: horse_love]
Cup final at 14:00 today, Silk Road Arena. Neftchi v Attelkom. Who is going?

Neftchi won the title already, they can afford to smile. Still a long way from winning the cup
Kyz kuu demo before the final, don't be late. I need a fresh whip 😂
